chunks: A number of our companions narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr; and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa; and Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father — all from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Zurarah who said:
When a man leaves behind his mother, or his father, or his son, or his daughter — when he leaves behind any one of the four — then this is not what God, Mighty and Majestic, intended in His Book:
'Say, God gives you a ruling regarding al-kalalah.'
No one among all the creatures of God, Mighty and Majestic, inherits along with the mother, or along with the father, or along with the son, or along with the daughter — except a husband or a wife.

key_terms.الأربعة: The four: the four primary lineal relatives — mother, father, son, and daughter — whose presence excludes collateral heirs
key_terms.الكلالة: Al-kalalah: a Quranic term (4:176) referring to one who dies without direct lineal heirs (no parents, no children); the term governs the inheritance of siblings
key_terms.يُفتيكم: Gives you a legal ruling/fatwa; the Quranic command in 4:176 authorizes God's ruling on this matter

ai.seo_question: Who inherits along with parents and children in Islamic inheritance law according to al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Zurarah reports a ruling from the Imam clarifying the Quranic term 'al-kalalah' (Quran 4:176). The hadith establishes that the kalalah ruling — governing inheritance of those without lineal heirs — does not apply when any one of the four primary relatives (mother, father, son, or daughter) is present. With any of these four, no collateral heir can inherit except the spouse. This is a foundational Shia jurisprudential ruling on inheritance that restricts collateral heirs in the presence of lineal ones.
word_analysis: al-kalalah (one who dies without parents or children)

en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr and Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father all from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah who has narrated the following: “

If a deceased leaves behind his mother, or father, or his son or his daughter with one of these four then what Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has spoken about, ‘Allah gives you a fatwa about al -Kalalah’ [4:176] does not apply.
With the existence of the mother, father, son or daughter no one of the creatures of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, inherits except the husband and wife/”
